name: Chthonic Tiefling

traits.name: Chthonic Resistance
traits.description: You have 50 percent resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Chill Touch Cantrip
traits.description: You know the Chill Touch cantrip.

traits.name: False Life
traits.description: Starting at character level 3, you always have False Life prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest and can also cast it using available spell slots of the appropriate level.

traits.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
traits.description: Starting at character level 5, you always have Ray of Enfeeblement prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest and can also cast it using available spell slots of the appropriate level.

reviewNotes: Choose the Ancestry's spellcasting ability when selecting it. The choice also governs the Thaumaturgy cantrip inherited from species.tiefling.
The level-3 and level-5 free castings are independent, with each spell replenishing after a Long Rest. They do not consume spell slots when used for free.
Additional older-edition Tiefling resistances, spells, and creature-type alternatives have not been stacked with this initial lineage.
